title: Canvas Low-Code Operante: Edição de Nós, Controles em Tempo Real e Persistência Bidirecional no LangGraph

tabs.name: parameters
tabs.label: Parâmetros
capabilities: Quick edit form for Assistant ID / LangGraph subgraph identifier
LLM model selection with presets (Google Antigravity Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, OMP Claude 3.7 Sonnet, etc.) or custom model
Custom system prompt editing for specific node guidance
Specialist contract fields injected dynamically based on 20 role schemas from @paperclipai/shared
Apply parameters locally and persist to agent in backend database

tabs.name: controls
tabs.label: Controles & Ações
capabilities: Botão Executar Nó Isolado: triggers individual test run via LangGraph Server API
Botão / Toggle Bypass / Mock: skips execution and provides custom mock output during rapid testing
Botão / Toggle Forçar Pausa (HITL): marks node for mandatory pipeline pause requiring human approval
Immediate execution feedback card with latency, status, and output data

tabs.name: telemetry
tabs.label: Telemetria & Artefatos
capabilities: Input and output artifacts inspection with copy-to-clipboard functionality
Live execution terminal logs viewer with monospace styling
Execution history list displaying past runs with timestamps and status badges

actions.description: Persists modified node parameters and controls into Paperclip backend (agents table / adapter_config and metadata), updating corresponding agents
Dispatches an end-to-end test run against local LangGraph to validate full pipeline DAG connectivity, contract schemas, and HITL gates
Downloads full graph definition, nodes, edges, active parameters, and runtime controls as JSON for auditability

badges_and_states: Running: Animated pulsing badge and border highlight for active nodes
Bypass / Mock: Amber badge and dashed border indicating simulated node execution
HITL Forced: Red destructive badge indicating mandatory human intervention breakpoint

endpoints.summary: Execute isolated LangGraph node test with bypass, HITL, and mock output support
Homologate complete LangGraph assistant pipeline flow validating contracts and gates
